title.value: Ethics of Corporeal, Co-present Robots as Agents of Influence: a Review
title.justification: The title clearly states the focus of the paper on the ethics of robots that interact physically with humans.
title.quote: Ethics of Corporeal, Co-present Robots as Agents of Influence: a Review

analysis.description: This paper reviews the unique ethical challenges posed by physical and interactive robots due to their corporeality, co-presence, and influence on humans, distinct from AI or virtual agents.

type.justification: The paper discusses ethical frameworks and theories relating to robots, rather than empirical data or experiments.
type.quote: Purpose of Review To summarize the set of roboethics issues that uniquely arise due to the corporeality and physical interaction modalities afforded by robots.

name.justification: The paper focuses on ethical issues specifically related to the physical interaction of robots.
name.quote: Recent Findings One of the recent trends in the discussion of ethics of emerging technologies has been the treatment of roboethics issues as those of “embodied AI,” a subset of AI ethics.

name.justification: The paper frequently discusses the impact of robots on human behavior, a topic central to Human-Robot Interaction.
name.quote: Recent work in human-robot interaction highlights the impact a robot’s presence, capacity to touch, and move in our physical environment has on people.
